variants.name: structured_json
variants.prompt_suffix: Return exactly one JSON object and no other text. Use this schema: {"evidence":["table field and year"],"formula":"numeric arithmetic formula","value":0,"unit":"million|percent|dollars|shares|"}. Preserve the table column, row, year, and unit in evidence. The value must be the final answer.

variants.name: evidence_operation
variants.prompt_suffix: Return exactly one JSON object and no other text. Do not output a final value. Use this schema: {"evidence":[{"row":"exact table row","column":"exact year or column","value":"cell value"}],"operands":[0,0],"operation":"subtract","unit":"million|percent|dollars|shares|"}. Evidence must identify the exact table cells used. operands must be numeric values copied from evidence, in calculation order; for percent_change use [new, old]. operation must be one of add, subtract, absolute_difference, multiply, divide, average, ratio, percent_change. The program will calculate the final answer deterministically.
